shared_elements: bearded male human figures in strict profile
low-relief carving of figures on a flat ground
rows/files of figures facing the same direction
stylised curled beards and hair rendered in regular rows of curls
hands raised holding objects (spear/reins vs. staff/weapon)
weapons or long shafts held vertically or diagonally
justification: Both show low-relief files of bearded men in strict profile facing one direction, with the same conventions for tightly curled stacked beard rows, profile eye, caps and gripped shafts, which is a specific shared manner of depicting the male figure. The subject matter differs sharply, however: A is a dynamic chariot scene with horses, wheels, a fallen enemy and a marsh/water ground line, while B is a static procession of robed standing attendants with no animals, vehicles or landscape.
